translation: Do not be angry. I wanted it for the men, <gap> so I took it.

translation: Give me my silver! He answered: I have not taken any of your silver. So, he cheated me with the account, for he has taken at least 1 or 2 minas of silver at my expense. We have borrowed tin, 1 talent, from Šalim-ahum on fixed terms, and he brought that into Burušhaddum where it was lost for me. Dont you know the state of affairs in the City? Here his fathers have become numerous, so we convened our colleagues, and they made us swear an oath by the City concerning the contractual agreement to pay the silver here , where they made us agree on 6 minas of silver: Reckoned from the month Tanbarta in the eponymy of Ibni-Adad son of Baqqunum he is to pay 1 mina per year without deduction to you in the City. He carries goods worth at least 1 or 2 minas of silver.

transliteration: a-li-ki-im ṭur₄-dam um-ma A-šur-i-dí-ma a-na A-šur-na-da qí-bi₄-ma: a-šu-mi I-dí-Sú-in ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni I-dí-Sú-in aš-ba-at-ma i-ma-ha-ar a-hi-ni um-ma a-na-ku-/ma KÙ.BABBAR i-na ba-a-ba-tí-a ta-al-ta-qé KÙ.BABBAR-pì dí-nam um-ma šu-ut-ma
translation: <gap> From Aššur-idī to Aššur-nāda: Concerning Iddin-Suen about whom you wrote, I seized Iddin-Suen and in the presence of our colleagues I said: You have taken silver from my outstanding claims!

transliteration: li-dí-in-ma KÙ.BABBAR lu-šé-bi-lam la ú-wa-šar a-pu-tum a-na i-ta-aṭ-li-im lu-qí-tám dì-in-ma
translation: He must not release it . Please, sell the goods for cash on delivery and send me his half of the silver raised.

transliteration: i-na a-wa-tim ip-tù-a-kà um-ma a-ta-ma ma-lá i-na É a-bi-kà i-še-ri-a i-lá-qé-ú-ni i-na šé-ri-kà a-lá-qé: ṭup-pá-kà ù ší-bé-kà
translation: You should answer: Whatever they will take at my expense in your fathers house, I shall take at your expense! See to it that your tablet and your witnesses are in order! Release the goods.

transliteration: da-ni-in: lu-qí-tám wa-šé-er um-ma A-šùr-i-dí-ma a-na A-šùr-na-da qí-bi₄-ma a-šù-mi KÙ.BABBAR ša Kà-ri-a ù ku-a-tí: ša tù-šé-bi-lá-ni um-ma ša ki-ma Kàr*-ri-a-ma lu-qí-tám a-na i-ta-aṭ-li-im
translation: <gap> From Aššur-idī to Aššur-nādā: With regard to the silver belonging to Karria and yourself which you sent to me, Karrias representatives said: Let him sell the goods for cash on delivery, and send the silver here!

transliteration: um-ma A-šur-i-dí-ma a-na A-šur-na-da qí-bi₄-ma 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na e-ra-bi₄-šu-ma Ás-qú-dí-a ša-áṣ-qí-il₅-ma iš-tí ší-im ANŠE ku-nu-uk-ma i-pá-ni-e-ma
translation: From Aššur-idī to Aššur-nāda: Make Asqudia pay 5 shekels of silver as soon as he arrives, seal that together with the money from the sale of the donkey, <gap> and send it as soon as possible.

transliteration: šé-bi₄-lam 1 TÚG ku-ta-nu-um i-ṭù-pì-a lá lá-pì-it ša A-šur-ta-ak-/lá-ku Ás-qú-dí-a-ma na-aš-a-/kum
translation: <gap> 1 kutānu-textile was not noted in my letter; it belongs to Aššur-taklāku; Asqudia is on his way to you with that as well.

transliteration: ù šé-ši-šu: tù-pá-šé-er ù kà-ki: ša A-šur ù A-šu-ri-tim im-hu-šú-/kà ù tù-pá-šé-er um-ma a-ta-ma i-na šé-ri-šu li-mu-ru ša a-wa-at: i-lí a-na ša ta-ni-iš-tim
translation: But though the weapons of divine Aššur and Aššuritum have hit you, you still broke your word, saying: Let them care about him who treats the words of the gods as those of mankind. So far you have not left.

transliteration: ri-im: šú-uh-ri-ma a-zu-áb: A-šur ù A-šu-ri-/tum uš-ta-na-ú-du-kà um-ma šu-nu-ma lá-am-na-/tim i-na li-bi₄-šu e-ta-wu li-bu-šu lá iš-ru-ni-ku-um qá-šu na-ba-al-ku-ta-at kà-lá a-wa-tim ša i-lí e-ta-wu-ni-ku-um a-wa-tim ša be-tí-ni: a-dí a-šu-ri-ma ta-am-tí-ši um-ma DINGIR-lu-ma a-wa-ti-ni ú-lá im-tù-a a-pu-tum a-wa-at
translation: Aššur and Aššuritum are giving you urgent instructions with the words: He speaks wickedness in his heart, his thoughts are not friendly towards you, his hand is turned away. All those words of the gods they spoke to you, words about our family, heaven forbid that you should have forgotten them! The gods said: He has refused to obey our commands! Please, obey the commands of the gods!

transliteration: ù a-wa-at i-lí iš-té-me li-ba-kà lá ú-lá-mì-in um-ma A-šur-i-dí-ma a-na A-šur-na-da qí-bi₄-ma ta-li-kam-ma: a-dí 5-ši-šu
translation: He cannot have made you angry. <gap> From Aššur-idī to Aššur-nāda: After you came here you have broken your promises five or six times!

transliteration: um-ma A-šur-i-dí-ma a-na Puzur-Ištar ù Ás-qú-dim qí-bi₄-ma 1 GÚ.5 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki ša Ás-qú-dum na-aš-ú a-na-ma Tí-me-el-ki-a ta-kà-ša-dá-/ni um-ma a-tù-nu-ma a-na Šu-Ištar DUMU A-zu-da qí-bi₄-a-ma tí-ir-tí A-šur-i-dí AN.NA 1 GÚ le-qé-ma gi-mì-lam i-na še-ri-šu šu-ku-un tup-pu-šu ha-ar-ma-am ša hu-bu-li-šu lu-up-ta a-na 25
translation: From Aššur-idī to Puzur-Ištar and Asqudum: As to the 1 talent 5 minas of tin under seal which Asqudum is bringing, as soon as you reach Timelkia you must say as follows to Šu-Ištar, the son of Azuda: Aššur-idis orders were that you should take at least 1 talent of tin to do him a favour. Draw up a certified tablet concerning his debt to run for 25 weeks.

transliteration: mì-ma a-hu-um a-na a-hi-im lá i-ša-kán a-pu-tum a-pu-tum i-hi-id-ma li-bi₄ lá tù-lá-ma-an
translation: Colleagues need not set witnesses for each other.Please, please! take care not to make me angry!

transliteration: um-ma A-šùr-i-dí-ma a-na A-šùr-na-da qí-bi-ma ša-am-ša-am ša 15 GÍN GUŠKIN a-na dNIN.ŠUBUR ha-bu-lá-/ku
translation: From Aššur-idī to Aššur-nādā: I owe a sun-disk weighing 15 shekels of gold to divine Ilabrat.

transliteration: i-na pá-ni-tim i-nu-mi ta-li-kà-ni um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-na mì-nim ša-am-ša-am la tù-ub-lam um-ma a-ta-ma 15 GÍN ù-la ma-ṣa-at um-ma a-na-ku-ma ší-ma-am ša-a-ma ta-er-ma i-na e-ra-bi-kà-ma ša-am-ša-am ša 15 GÍN GUŠKIN e-pu-uš-ma šé-bi-lam iš-tù šé-pí-kà pá-ni-tim tù-uš-ta-na-áb-la-kà-at
translation: Earlier, when you came here, I said: Why did you not bring the sun-disk? You answered: There was not enough for 15 shekels. So I said: Buy some goods, convert them, and make a sun-disk weighing 15 shekels of gold as soon as you arrive, and send it to me. Since the time of your first transport you have repeatedly had goods shipped.

transliteration: a-na mì-nim ik-ri-bi tu-kà-al
translation: Why, then, do you withhold my votive offerings?

transliteration: i-hi-id-ma ša-am-ša-am e-pu-uš-ma i-pá-nim-ma šé-bi-lam
translation: Take care to make the sun-disk and send it to me as soon as possible.

transliteration: ù šu-ma ù-tù-ra-ú i<-bi>-ší-ú a-qé'-er-bi-ma
translation: Also, if anything extra becomes available, then put it into it.

transliteration: i-dì TÚG.HI-tí ša ik-ri-bi ša A-šùr a-na mì-nim la i-ba-la-ku-tù a-dí-ni a-na KÙ.BABBAR la i-tù-ru
translation: As to my textiles from the votive offering for divine Aššur, why are they not being shipped? So far they have not been exchanged for silver.

transliteration: 1 me-at 90 TÚG.HI-tí Ì-lì-a-lúm ù A-šùr-ta/ak-la-ku ù-ša-áb-ší-lu-ni-kum
translation: 190 of my textiles Ilī-alum and Aššur-taklāku have dealt with for you.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu-nu Ēʾ ma-nim i-ba-šì
translation: In whose house is the money they were sold for?

transliteration: a-na DINGIR da-am-qá-at i-bu-ul-tí-a-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pí ša-ni-ú-tum ù-la-pu-tù
translation: Is this good in the eyes of the god— that while I am still alive others may touch silver belonging to me?

transliteration: rû' šu-ma ša' DAM.GÀR-ri-im a-šé-ri-a-ma šé-bi-lam-ma šì-ma-am la-áš-a-ma lu-ta-e-ra-kum
translation: But if it is tamkāru-property, then send it to me, so I can carry out purchases and return to you.

transliteration: rû' a-na-ku-ma ù-lá a-ma-ša-ah-kà
translation: In that case I shall certainly not rob you!

transliteration: um-ma A-šùr-i-dí-ma a-na A-šùr-na-da qí-bi-/ma mì-šú ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni
translation: From Aššur-idī to Aššur-nādā: Why have you written to me.

transliteration: um-ma a-ta-ma i-na KÙ.BABBAR-kà ni-kà-ši-/a
translation: as follows: I shall pay my accounts with your silver.

transliteration: a-ša-qal pá-kà ta-dí-/nam pá-i: ù-la a-dí-na-/kum
translation: You gave me your word. I did not give you my word!

transliteration: ù tù-šà-li-a-ma IGI A-šùr-ka-ši-id 20 TÚG ku-ta-ni a-qí-ša-kum
translation: However, you begged me, so with Aššur-kāšid as witness I gave you a gift of 20 kutānu-textiles.

transliteration: iš-tù a-wa-tù-ni gám-ra-ni lu i-ši-im TÚG.HI-tí: lu i-ši-im ANŠE.HI.A KÙ.BABBAR pá-ni-a-ma 10 ma-na šé-bi-lá-ma 2 GÚ AN.NA la-áš-a-ma lu-šé-bi-la-ku-ma né-ma-al-šu
translation: Since our affairs are concluded, you must send me at least ten minas of silver both from the proceeds of the textiles and from the proceeds of the donkeys, the first silver you may obtain, I shall then buy two talents of tin and send that to you, so you can enjoy the profit.

transliteration: a-kùl: mì-ma i-na
translation: Do not use any of my silver!

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-pì-a: la ta*-kál
translation: If you wish, then stand!

transliteration: li-ba-kà i-zi-iz
translation: If you do not wish to, then dont stand.

transliteration: li-ba-kà la ta-za-az me-ra-kà: ú-ra-bi-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma lá a-bi a-ta
translation: I have raised your son, but he said to me: You are not my father. He got up and left.

transliteration: it-bi-a-ma: i-tal-kam ù me-er-ú-wa-tí-kà ù-ra-bi-ma um-ma ši-na-ma: la a-bu-ni a-ta i-na ša-al-/ší-ma u₄-mi-im it-bi-a-ma i-tal-kà-ku-ma tí-ir-ta-kà lu i-de₈
translation: Also your daughters have I raised, but they said: You are not our father. Three days later they got up and left to go to you, so let me know what you think.

transliteration: um-ma A-lá-hu-um ù «ù» A-šur-i-dí-ma a-na A-šur-na-da ù Šu-A-šur qí-bi-ma a-na A-šur-na-da qí-bi-ma i-na ù-mi-im ša tup-pá-am ta-ša-me-a-ni 1 GÚ AN.NA ku-nu-ki ša A-lim^ki Šu-A-šur li-dí-na-ku-ma i-na e-tí-šu 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am šu-qú-ul-šu-um
translation: From Alāhum and Aššur-idī to Aššur-nādā and Šū-Aššur; to Aššur-nādā: the same day that you hear the letter Šū-Aššur shall give you 1 talent of tin under the seal of the City, and you must pay him 10 minas of refined silver promptly.

transliteration: mì-šu ša um-ma a-ta-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pí ta-as-ba-at
translation: Why is it that you say: You have seized my silver?

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà ki-a-ma at-ba-al i-na lu-qú-tim ša šé-ep En-nam-Be-lim
translation: Have I removed any of your silver in this way? Deduct it from the merchandise transported by Ennam-Bēlum.

transliteration: ṣa-hi-ra-am a-ta 15 ma-na ša ta-aq-bi-a-ni iš-tù A-bi-im a-šar li-bi-kà
translation: But you yourself, have you not sent the 15 minas that you promised me from Abum to where it pleased you?

transliteration: lá tù-šé-bi-il₅, KÙ.BABBAR ša šé-ep I-zi-me-a ù Hi-na-a u₄-mu-šu-nu e-ta-at-qú
translation: As to the silver transported by Izimea and Hinnaya, their terms are overdue.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR i-na pá-ni-ú-tì-ma
translation: Send the silver as soon as possible.

transliteration: šé-bi-lá-šu tup-pá-am ha-ar-ma-am ša ší-bu-tí Lá-qé-ep ù A-šùr-i-mi-tí DUMU A-mur-DINGIR i-na pá-ni wa-ṣa-i-šu tup-pá-am ša ší-bu-tí-šu ù ku-nu-ki-šu IGI iš-tí-in a-li-ki-im kà-li-im-šu ù a-wa-at ṭup-pí-im pá-sí-is
translation: With respect to the certified tablet with the testimony of Lā-qēp and Aššur-imittī son of Amur-ilī, before he leaves you must show him the tablet with his testimony and his seal with one of the travellers as witness, and then erase the words on the tablet.

transliteration: a-pu-tum AN.NA ša A-lá-hi-im le-qé-ma a-na a-hi-im ú eb-ri-im za-ri-šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu šu-qú-ul-šu-um
translation: Please, take Alāhums tin and scatter it among colleagues and friends and pay him his silver.

transliteration: um-ma A-šur-i-dí-ma a-na A-šur-na-da qí-bi-ma 1 GÚ AN.NA ša A-lá-hi-im Šu-A-šur li-dí-na-/ku-ma 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na e-tí-šu šu-qú-ul-šum
translation: From Aššur-idī to Aššur-nādā: Šu-Aššur should give you 1 talent of tin that belongs to Alāhum, and then pay him 10 minas of refined silver promptly.

transliteration: ku-nu-ki ša A-lim^ki 2 šu-uq-li-in li-dí-a-ku-ma eš-té-et ú-sú-uq
translation: He should place 2 containers under the seal of the City authorities before you, and then you choose one of them.

transliteration: um-ma A-šur-i-dí-ma a-na A-šur-na-da qí-bi₄-ma mì-šu ša ta-aš-pu-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma um-ma DUMU A-lá-hi-im-ma 10 ma-na KÙ ša a-bi₄-kà a-ṣa-ba-at KÙ.BABBAR-pi i-na ki-dí''-im za-ru šu-ma šu-ut 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣa-ba-at a-ta 11 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-bi₄-šu
translation: From Aššur-idī to Aššur-nādā: Why have you written me as follows: Alāhums son said to me: I shall seize 10 minas of silver belonging to your father. My silver has been scattered around outside! If he seizes 10 minas of silver, then you must seize 11 minas of his fathers silver!

transliteration: ṣa-ba-at mì-na-am a-na a-bi₄-šu ha-bu-lá-ku-ma ma KÙ.BABBAR-pi i-ṣa-ba-at
translation: What do I owe to his father, so that—really!—he can seize my silver?

transliteration: šu-ma ma KÙ.BABBAR ha-bu-lá-ak-/šu-um šé-bi₄-šu li-ir-dí-a-/ma ú-lá tup-pu-šu ha-ar-ma-am lu-ub-lam-ma KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu a-na-kam ša-qá-lá-am
translation: If indeed I owe him any silver, then let him produce his witnesses, or let him bring a certified tablet that I was unable to pay his silver here!

transliteration: lá a-le-e um-ma a-bu-šu-ma giš-im-lá-ni AN.NA-kà-am
translation: His father said to me: Do me a favour!

transliteration: 1 GÚ ša ik-ri-be le-qé-ma 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR lá ta-ba-ta-qá-am 1 GÚ AN.NA šu-uq-lam wa-sú-um-tám le-qé-ma iš-tù u₄-mi-im ša ta-lá-qé-ú a-na e-tí-šu 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am dí-šu-um
translation: take some tin, 1 talent from the votive gifts, and do not go lower than 10 minas of silver . Take, therefore, a suitable packet of 1 talent of tin and after the day you receive it pay him 10 minas of refined silver promptly.

transliteration: um-ma A-šur-i-dí-ma a-na A-šur-na-da qí-bí₄-ma mì-šu ša ta-aš-pu-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma i-na KÙ.BABBAR-pi-kà DUMU A-lá-hi-im i-ṣa-ba-at ma-nam ha-bu-lá-ku-ma ta-am-giš-ir-tí-ni 2 GÚ AN.NA ku-nu-ki ša A-lim^ki Šu-A-šur ma-ah-ri-kà i-šá-kà-an-ma i-2 ší-ta iš-té-et ta-na-sà-aq-ma 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na e-tí-kà ta-šá'-qal
translation: From Aššur-idī to Aššur-nādā: Why have you written me as follows: Alāhums son will seize some of your silver? To whom do I owe anything, since it was our agreement that Šu-Aššur will place 2 talents of tin under the seal of the City authorities, before you and you will choose one of the two and pay 10 minas of silver promptly.

transliteration: ù tup-pá-am šu-a-tí Šu-A-šur i-sé-pì-šu
translation: Moreover, that very tablet Šu-Aššur brought you personally!

transliteration: ub-lá-kum mì-šu KÙ.BABBAR
translation: Why should he seize any silver?

transliteration: ša i-ṣa-bu-tù i-na a-wa-tim
translation: He is depriving you with words.

transliteration: i-pu-a-kà a-pu-uh' 2 ší-ta šu-uq-le-en iš-té-ta-ma ú-kà-li-im-kà ù ší-it-ma pá-at-ra-at
translation: Instead of two containers he showed you only one; moreover, that one had been opened!

transliteration: šu-ma ma mì-ma a-na a-bí₄-šu ha-bu-lá-ku li-iš-pu-ra-ma a-na a-bí₄-šu a-bu-šu a-na-kam li-iš-ba-ta-ni
translation: If indeed I owe anything to his father, then let him write to his father, so that his father can seize me here.

transliteration: a-ma-kam ki-ma ta-le-e-ú AN.NA le-qé-ma ki-ma a-wi-lu-tí-kà e-pu-uš-ma KÙ.BABBAR dí-šu-nu-tí a-ma-kam
translation: Take what tin you are able to there, and act like a gentleman and give them the silver.

translation: From Aššur-idī to Aššur-nādā:

translation: Earlier, when you came here, I said:

transliteration: a-na mì-nim ša-am-ša-am la tù-ub-lam um-ma a-ta-ma
translation: Why did you not bring the sun-disk? You answered:

translation: There was not enough for 15 shekels. So I said: Buy some goods, convert them, and make a sun-disk weighing 15 shekels of gold as soon as you arrive, and send it to me. Since the time of your first transport you have repeatedly had goods shipped.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR-pì-a: la ta-kál

transliteration: it-bi-a-ma: i-tal-kam ù me-er-ú-wa-tí-kà

translation: You are not our father. Three days later they got up and left to go to you, so let me know what you think.

translation: From Alāhum and Aššur-idī to Aššur-nādā and Šū-Aššur; to Aššur-nādā:

transliteration: mì-šu ša um-ma a-ta-ma
translation: Why is it that you say:

translation: As to the silver transported by Izimea and Hinnaya, their terms are overdue.

transliteration: um-ma A-šur-i-dí-ma a-na A-šur-na-da qí-bi-ma
translation: From Aššur-idī to Aššur-nādā:

transliteration: 1 GÚ AN.NA ša A-lá-hi-im Šu-A-šur li-dí-na- ku-ma 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na e-tí-šu šu-qú-ul-šum

translation: He should place 2 containers under the seal of the City authorities before you, and then you choose one of them.

transliteration: um-ma A-šur-i-dí-ma a-na A-šur-na-da qí-bi4-ma mì-šu
translation: From Aššur-idī to Aššur-nādā:

transliteration: ša ta-aš-pu-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma um-ma DUMU

translation: What do I owe to his father, so that—really!—he can seize my silver?

translation: If indeed I owe him any silver, then let him produce his witnesses, or let him bring a certified tablet that I was unable to pay his silver here!

transliteration: lá a-le-e um-ma a-bu-šu-ma
translation: His father said to me:

transliteration: giš-im-lá-ni AN.NA-kà-am
translation: Do me a favour!

transliteration: ha-bu-lam i-nu-mì wa-áš-ba-ku-ni aš-ba-sú-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma ú-nu-tí : a-dí-ni lá e-ru-ba-am a-hu-a : a-tù-nu ṣa-áb-ta-šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú ma-lá wa-as-mu ša-aš-qí-lá-šu
translation: When I stayed there I seized him, but he said: My merchandise has not arrived yet. My dear brothers, seize him and make him pay the silver and as much interest as is fitting.

transliteration: dí-na-šu nu-hi-in ša-ma-ma ANŠE Ì.GIŠ ma-li-a-ma šé-bi-lá-nim ù ma-lá ki-lá-li-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
translation: Buy two leather pouches, load a donkey with oil, and send it to me. Do send as much as both can contain.

transliteration: mì-šu ša am-tum ta-li-ku-ma ú-qá- li-lu-šu
translation: How come that when the maid went, he insulted her?

transliteration: né-ma-al KÙ.BABBAR-pì-a ša iš-tù 10 ša-na- tim i-be-e-lu KÙ.BABBAR ša-aš-qí-il-šú-ma a-na a-am-tim
translation: The profit accrued on my silver, over which he has disposed for 10 years, make him pay that silver, and give it to the maid.

transliteration: dí-in šu-ma mì-ma i-qá-bi4 šu-ga-ri- a-am ša A-šur li-it-ma-ma ú li-it-ba-al- šú
translation: If he protests in any way, then let him swear by divine Aššurs šugariʾāʾum and only after that can he take it away.

transliteration: a-pu-tum lá ta-ga- mi-il-šú
translation: Please, do not show him any favour.

transliteration: ú-rul¹ KÙ.BABBAR li-iš-qú-ul ú-ul ta-mì-šu
translation: Either he pays the silver or you make him take an oath!

transliteration: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí Ha-ar-ta-al
translation: 15 shekels of silver is owed by Hartal.

transliteration: KÙ.BABBAR ša-aš-qí-il-šú- ma <gap> ¹ ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša Du-du 0.5 ma-na KI. Ša-ra-pu-nu-a ša-aš-qí-lá- ma a-na a-am-tim dí-in
translation: Make him pay the silver and have paid <gap> mina 6 shekels of silver belonging to Dudu 0.5 mina owed by Šarapunuwa, and give it to the maid .

transliteration: a-na A-šùr-na-da qí-bi-ma um-ma Ša-ša-ah-šu-šar-ma ki-ma a-ta : tù-šú-ni 0.66666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR im-hu-ru-ma a-na Ú-šú-ur-ša-A-šùr DUMU A-šùr-ma-lik i-dí-nu
translation: To Aššur-nādā from Šašaḫšušar: Since you had left they have received 0.66666 mina 5 shekels of silver and given that to Uṣur-ša-Aššur son of Aššur-malik.

transliteration: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI Ša-ra-pu-nu-wa im-hu-ru-ma i-a-tí : i-dí-nu-ni-šú
translation: They received 12 shekels of silver from Šarapunūwa and gave that to me.

transliteration: 3 na-ru-uq GIG É Kà-ú-ba-a ub-lu-nim
translation: The house of Kaʾuba brought 3 sacks of wheat.

transliteration: ki-ma a-ta tù-šú-ni A-šùr-bé-el-a-wa-tim i-li-kam-ma maš-ke-e i-zu-a-aš zi-ta-kà-a i-ib-ši-ma ù a-ni-i i-ta-áb-lu-šu-nu 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša Ta-ar-hu-nu ší-tí : KÙ ha-bu-lu-ú ŠÀ 8.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-dí-nu-nim
translation: Since you have left Aššur-bēl-awātim came here and divided up the hides; your share used to be here, but now they have removed them. 15 shekels of silver from Tarhunu, they owe the rest of the silver; thereof they have given me 8.25 shekels of silver.
